finding: The oriented weight-three virtual entry requires the additive conjugation correction in 133. Subject to that correction, the following direct matrix-unit reconstructions agree with the displayed 121 Hessian coefficient matrices; this author audit is not a disjoint proof or adoption.
local_rules: At shrinkage t, a=(1+t)/2, b=(1-t)/2: |0><0| maps to diag(a,b), |1><1| maps to diag(b,a), and |0><1|,|1><0| each acquire factor t.
reconstructed_steps: For normalized weight-two v=sum c_ij|ij>, W00=a^2 b^2-a^4=-a^2 t, V_(ij,0)=a^2 t^2 c_ij, and lambda0-lambda2=a^2 t, hence A2=-a^2 t(1-t^2).

With n_i=sum_j|c_ij|^2 and Gamma_ij=sum_l c_il conjugate(c_jl), W_ii=-ab t(1-n_i), W_ij=ab t^2 Gamma_ij (i!=j). The virtual weight-three products use gap lambda1-lambda3=ab t and add ab t^3(1-n_i) to the diagonal and ab t^3 Gamma_ij off diagonal. This recovers all of 121 equation (17), including complex conjugation.
For normalized v3=sum_i g_i|bar i>, D3=1-ab: W00=ab^3-a^4=-a t D3, V_(bar i,0)=a t^3 g_i, lambda0-lambda3=a t D3, hence A3=-a t D3+a t^5/D3.

In weight one, W_ii=-a^2 b t-b^2 t |g_i|^2 and W_ij=b^2 t^2 conjugate(g_i)g_j (i!=j). The correctly oriented virtual entries are V_(i,1111)=b t^3 conjugate(g_i), reverse b t^3 g_i, with lambda1-lambda4=b t D3. Their products add b t^5 conjugate(g_i)g_j/D3, recovering equation (18)'s conjugate(g)conjugate(g)^dagger and its diagonal subtraction.

For the weight-four basis direction, W00=b^4-a^4=-t(a^2+b^2), V_(1111,0)=t^4, lambda0-lambda4=t(a^2+b^2), and W_ii=ab^3-a^3b=-ab t; there is no weight-five virtual sector. This recovers equation (20).

Mixed-weight terms vanish in the two leading diagonal blocks by total excitation-number covariance; the weight-h first-order input couples weight one only to weight h+1, so a fixed virtual k cannot mix distinct h in M. Zero weight components are omitted rather than normalized.
